categories.main_business_segments: Ta Yih Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in manufacturing and sales of automotive, motorcycle, rail vehicle, aerospace, and ship lighting products and molds. The company also engages in import and export trading of these products and related equipment. Key product categories include car lights, molds, and other related parts, with automotive lighting accounting for the majority of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced automotive lighting technologies such as intelligent and interactive lighting systems including adaptive front lighting systems (AFS), dynamic ground projection lamps, and compact fog lamps with corner functions. It employs precision optical design, LED and laser light sources, miniaturized dual convex lens BIPES technology, and in-mold decoration (IMD/IML) for interior lighting. Production methods emphasize modular design, energy efficiency, and compliance with international safety standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ta Yih serves major OEM customers in the automotive and motorcycle assembly industries, as well as rail vehicle manufacturers. Its key markets include Taiwan, the United States, Japan, China, and other regions, with Taiwan accounting for over 58% of sales. The company also targets high-end vehicle models, electric vehicles, and public transportation sectors with specialized lighting solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Tainan City. Its sales and export markets include the United States, Japan, China, and other international regions. It actively develops overseas markets through collaborations with international automotive manufacturers and participation in global exhibitions and technology forums.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ta Yih operates in the midstream segment of the automotive lighting supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying lighting components and molds to OEMs and assembly factories. It sources raw materials such as plastics and optical components from both local and overseas suppliers and delivers finished lighting products to vehicle manufacturers and maintenance factories downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in intelligent automotive lighting technologies, including adaptive lighting, dynamic projection, and health-oriented lighting for public transport. It invests in smart lighting, energy-saving optics, and modular designs to enhance safety, brand identity, and environmental sustainability. Digital transformation initiatives such as IoT, AI, and Industry 4.0 are also key focuses to improve operational efficiency and product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Ta Yih generates revenue primarily through product sales of automotive, motorcycle, rail vehicle, aerospace, and ship lighting products and molds. Revenue is derived from OEM contracts, export orders, and domestic sales. The company does not report subscription or licensing income, focusing instead on manufacturing and trading activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a global automotive lighting market dominated by major international players such as Germany's Hella and Osram, France's Valeo, and Japan's Koito Manufacturing Co., Ltd., which is also a major shareholder of Ta Yih. Taiwanese manufacturers face competition from Chinese firms in mid- to low-end markets. Ta Yih positions itself as Taiwan's largest OEM automotive lighting manufacturer, emphasizing R&D innovation, quality, and strategic partnerships to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ta Yih reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$3.7 billion, a 23.27% decrease from 2023, with net income increasing by 106.15% to NT$87.4 million. The company has a debt-to-assets ratio of 33.85% and a return on equity of 2.37%. R&D expenses accounted for 4.33% of net operating income in 2024. The company expects stable sales volume in 2025 with ongoing efforts to improve production efficiency and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ta Yih emphasizes advanced, intelligent lighting technologies that enhance driving safety, brand identity, and environmental sustainability. Its product differentiation lies in customizable projection lamps, adaptive lighting systems for motorcycles and vehicles, energy-efficient optical designs, and health-focused lighting for public transportation. The company leverages precision optics, modular designs, and integration with emerging technologies to offer innovative, high-quality lighting solutions tailored to customer needs.
